form.label: Attack Detection Lab - Investigation Dashboard
form.description: One-screen view of the finuser01 investigation: beaconing, persistence and cross-source timeline. Import via Dashboards > Create New Dashboard > Source.

search.query: index=main source="proxy.log" | stats count by dest_host | sort - count | head 10

panel.title: Beacon candidates: regular interval, low jitter

search.query: index=main source="proxy.log" | sort 0 _time | streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev by src_ip, dest_host | eval gap=_time-prev | stats count, avg(gap) as avg_gap_s, stdev(gap) as jitter_s, sum(bytes_out) as bytes_out by src_ip, dest_host | where count>=20 | eval avg_gap_s=round(avg_gap_s,1), jitter_s=round(jitter_s,1) | sort jitter_s

panel.title: Connection timeline for top beacon destination

search.query: index=main source="proxy.log" user=$user$ | timechart span=1m count by dest_host limit=5
index=main source="wineventlog.log" EventCode=4698 | eval suspicious=if(match(TaskContent,"(?i)-enc|-w hidden|-nop"),"yes","no") | table _time, host, user, TaskName, TaskContent, suspicious
index=main user=$user$ | table _time, source, EventCode, dest_host, dest_ip, bytes_out | sort _time
